summary: Appends a value to a doubly-linked list container. Allocates an 8-byte data node holding the value and a 16-byte list node, links it at the tail, bumps the item count, recomputes size statistics, and signals a change through a vtable method. Returns 1 on success, 0 when the data node allocation fails.

operations.description: allocate 8-byte data node via heap allocator
store appended value into data node at offset +4
if data node allocation returned zero, return 0
allocate 16-byte list node via heap allocator
initialize list node: value pointer at +0, previous 0 at +4, next 0 at +8, in-list flag 1 at +12
branch on whether head pointer at +0x31C is already set
existing list: link old tail forward pointer to new node and new node previous to old tail
empty list: set head pointer at +0x31C and first-element pointer at +0x324 to the new node
update tail pointer at +0x320 to the new node
recompute list size statistics after insertion
notify change via vtable method at index 44 with argument 1
